name: TCL
verdict: TCL is the consumer-electronics brand of TCL Electronics Holdings (HKEX: 01070), controlled by TCL Industries Holdings. Nothing found.
note: Al-Ittihad sponsor for two seasons from October 2025 (men's and women's first teams), signed through Alesayi Electronics, TCL's exclusive distributor in Saudi Arabia; the TCL logo sits on the right shoulder of the men's team jerseys.
